summary: SCWorx Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a September 16, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with ten accredited investors for a private placement of 350,000 common shares plus warrants for 350,000 shares at a combined $2.68 per share-and-warrant, raising $938,000 gross before expenses. Warrants carry a $2.56 exercise price, are immediately exercisable, expire five years out, allow cashless exercise absent an effective resale registration, and include fundamental-transaction Black-Scholes cash-out rights. No advisor, board recommendation, or premium was disclosed. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch dilution, warrant overhang, and resale registration timing.
